invalidation_rules: model/runtime version, build, commit, or required flag mismatch
git_dirty is true for publication campaign execution
missing mandatory telemetry or trace artifacts
any admission failure unless the specific analysis explicitly models admission control
incorrect mechanism configuration or failed mechanism verification
insufficient disk space below frozen guard

queue_confounded.downstream: requests_deferred_max > 0 is VALID_WITH_SECONDARY_EFFECT unless it causes mandatory validity failure
queue_confounded.load: not a confound; queueing is the intended mechanism

rerun_policy.invalid_runs: May be rerun with a new attempt ID; preserve invalid artifacts and reason.
rerun_policy.valid_surprising_runs: Must not be silently rerun; surprising valid data are retained.

states.CONFUNDED: Mechanism was applied but a predefined secondary mechanism appeared.
states.VALID: All mandatory validity criteria pass and no disallowed confound is present.
states.VALID_WITH_SECONDARY_EFFECT: Run is usable for mechanism execution but excluded from pure-isolation claims.
